privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How Mokaair handles account, travel, community and usage information, and how to contact the operator.

blocks.text: Scope and contact

This document describes information processing when Mokaair provides travel discovery, itinerary planning and community features. The operator, location, contact channel, retention arrangements and other applicable information appear in the confirmed information on this page. External websites have their own privacy policies.
Account and travel information

items: Registration and sign-in involve email, password hashes, verification and session state, and language and currency preferences. Third-party sign-in involves the identity information supplied by that service and the account-link status.

Depending on the features you use, the service stores search criteria, private itineraries, saved items, price-alert settings, usage balances, reservations and ledger records to provide features, protect accounts and reconcile usage charges.
Sign-in cookies maintain your session. Language and other preferences may be stored in cookies or browser storage. Disabling necessary browser storage can affect sign-in or preferences.

blocks.text: Community sharing and messages

You create a public profile separately; your email does not automatically become a public display name. Profile details, posts, comments and images you choose to publish may be visible to others. Public itineraries use separate snapshots and do not automatically reveal private notes, actual accommodation, flights, bookings, traveller details or original quotes.

Image processing removes metadata such as EXIF and creates display versions. Draft and pending media have access restrictions. Withdrawing content stops new public access authorizations, but the website cannot recall copies already downloaded. Messages, reports and necessary moderation information support communication, safety and complaint handling; blocking does not remove messages already delivered to another person.
Service providers and usage analytics

Depending on the feature and its enabled settings, information may be processed by services for email, image storage, maps, travel information, AI planning or translation. Avoid including unnecessary personal or sensitive information in planning requests. Actual providers, processing locations and arrangements must be stated in the operator's confirmed information.

Usage analytics can be enabled through website settings and includes page and feature events, language, device categories, source types and hashed identifiers. The implementation supports browser DNT and GPC opt-out signals and optional GA4 configuration. Message bodies are not used as analytics event content; this does not mean that records needed for sign-in, security and product features are never processed.
Retention, deletion and requests

Retention arrangements for each data category and backups appear in the confirmed information. Confirmed account deletion revokes access and hides public content, followed by background cleanup of related personal information and media. Retained historical accounting links and delivered conversations use a de-identified identity. Account cleanup does not immediately erase all backups or withdraw private itinerary copies that others have already created.

For questions, corrections or other information-processing requests, use the contact channel on this page and explain your request. Identity checks may be needed to protect the account. Do not provide passwords or unnecessary sensitive information.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.description: Using Mokaair's travel discovery, itinerary and community features, including important limitations.

blocks.text: Scope of the service

Mokaair helps people discover travel ideas, compare travel information, manage itineraries and share experiences. Available features and packages are those currently offered by the website. Operator details, contact information, eligible users, governing rules and dispute arrangements appear in the confirmed information on this page.
Account security and responsible use

Provide usable account information and protect your sign-in credentials. Do not impersonate others, bypass access restrictions, disrupt the service, send unwanted messages or attempt to access information without authorization. If you discover unauthorized account use, contact the operator through the stated channel promptly.
Travel information, external services and AI

Prices, availability, flights and venue rules can change. Confirm important details with the actual provider before travelling or paying. Read the provider's terms when following links to booking, ticketing or other external websites. Mokaair's comparisons and planning content do not replace an actual third-party order or contract.

AI planning, translation, transport estimates and traveller contributions can be incomplete or incorrect. Check them against your needs. Interpret pet-friendly information by species, conditions and verification date: unknown does not mean permitted. Confirm a venue's latest rules before visiting.
Usage credits and packages

Metered features use the effective cost settings when an operation starts; the interface displays the required credits or a free status. New settings do not retroactively rewrite existing reservations or historical ledger records. A package is purchasable only when an actual purchase flow is available. Displaying a package does not mean payment or issuance has occurred.
Community content, moderation and complaints

Before uploading or publishing, make sure you have the right to use the content and images and avoid exposing another person's private or sensitive information. Do not publish infringing, fraudulent, harassing or otherwise prohibited material. Posts, comments and account interactions may be restricted under moderation rules. Questions about a decision can be raised through the stated contact channel.

You can preview a public itinerary and choose whether others may copy it. Editing a private itinerary does not automatically change its public version. Withdrawing a public version does not recall private copies that others were previously allowed to create.
Service changes and contact

Features may change because of maintenance, provider availability or security needs. Consult the confirmed information on this page and in the privacy policy for specific user-rights, retention, governing-law and dispute arrangements. Check the displayed version and effective date when reading an update.

about.title: About Mokaair
about.description: From travel inspiration and place discovery to your own itinerary: meet Mokaair.

blocks.text: Mokaair helps you explore travel ideas, compare information and organize itineraries. We want to make it easier to turn inspiration into a personal plan you can adjust and save.
Put information in the context of a trip

Using the features currently available, you can explore places and merchants, compare travel options, and manage itineraries and saved items. Community contributions and pet-friendly information offer different perspectives and verification leads, not a promise of complete coverage for every destination.
Keep sources visible and make your own decision

Place information, provider data and traveller experiences have different sources and freshness. Check the displayed sources and review or verification status, and reconfirm important details before visiting or buying.

The interface supports Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean. The actual operator and contact details appear in the confirmed information on this page. Feature availability and data coverage are limited to what the website actually provides.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.description: Contact Mokaair about accounts, information, content and using the service.

blocks.text: For account questions, data corrections, content reports, privacy requests or collaboration enquiries, use the public contact channel in the confirmed information on this page.
Information that helps us respond

items: Briefly describe the type of issue, when it happened and the relevant page or public-content link.
If account verification is needed, follow the reply's instructions and provide only the necessary information. Do not send passwords, full payment details or unnecessary personal information.
When reporting incorrect venue information or rules, include a source link and verification date if available, and distinguish a personal experience from an official policy.

blocks.text: This page provides contact information only; it does not automatically submit a support case. Existing reporting and account controls can be used according to their instructions. Actual contact and handling arrangements are those stated by the operator.
